test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they do not seem to be in accordance with the real world knowledge, decide which of the given conclusions/possibilities can be true based on the statements. 

**Statements** : 

Some games are cricket. 

Some crickets are tennis. 

All tennis are balls. 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some tennis are games. 

II. Some balls are games. 

III. Some balls are crickets.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II are true.
